problem.title: The infrastructure the market was waiting for.
problem.subheader: MentivisOS brings together what no LMS, no AI tool, and no consulting firm can offer alone: the ability to build, deploy, and operate skills transformation end to end.
problem.body: Each profile generates its own path. Each step is reassessed. Each skill is measured as such, not as a proxy for hours spent online. And before any deployment, the system produces a feasibility analysis and risk scoring, because the real question isn't "did the employee complete the module" but "is the organization truly capable of transforming what was learned".

impact.title: Why pedagogical expertise before technology ?
body: MentivisOS was not designed by a startup discovering the training sector. The system is driven by a firm that has been designing, structuring and operating pedagogical programs for several years.

This professional experience fundamentally changes the logic of the AI used in the platform. The generated pathways respect the operational realities of learning: progression, sequencing, skill acquisition, cognitive load and adaptation to business contexts.
The AI does not produce raw content. It relies on a pedagogical architecture designed to be usable, coherent and deployable at scale.

faq.title: Everything you need to know before getting started
faq.lead: Concise answers to the most common questions asked by training departments and operators.

items.question: Is MentivisOS an LMS?
items.answer: No. An LMS distributes content and tracks completion. MentivisOS builds, deploys, adapts, and measures real skills transformation within an organization. It's a pedagogical operating system, not a module library.

items.question: What sets MentivisOS apart from AI training tools?
items.answer: Most AI tools generate content. MentivisOS orchestrates the entire cycle: feasibility diagnostic, personalized path generation, skill-by-skill measurement, dynamic recalculation at each step, and risk analysis before deployment. AI isn't the feature. It's the infrastructure.

items.question: How does MentivisOS measure performance?
items.answer: Not by consumption. Not by completion rate. MentivisOS measures real acquisition, skill by skill, and adjusts paths based on detected gaps. What you manage is your teams' actual capability, not their presence in a module.

items.question: What types of organizations is MentivisOS for?
items.answer: Companies engaged in AI transformation, universities and grandes ecoles, hospital groups, training organizations, OPCOs, public administrations. MentivisOS is designed for organizations that need to operationalize large-scale skills development with compliance, governance, and integration constraints.

items.question: MentivisOS and data sovereignty?
items.answer: MentivisOS is designed for European sovereign hosting, compliant with GDPR requirements and data policies of public and semi-public institutions. Your skills data, content, and paths remain under your control on the infrastructure of your choice.

items.question: How does a deployment work?
items.answer: Every deployment begins with a transformation diagnostic: skills mapping, existing infrastructure analysis, AI maturity assessment, feasibility scoring. MentivisOS is then deployed by unit, department, or campus on a 90-day pilot cycle before any generalization. Mentivis handles implementation end to end.

items.question: What is Mentivis's role?
items.answer: Mentivis is the operator behind MentivisOS. It's not a publisher that delivers software and leaves you alone. Mentivis designs, deploys, and operates pedagogical transformation projects end to end, with expertise accumulated with institutions, companies, and ministries in France and internationally.

items.question: Where to start?
items.answer: With a diagnostic. We audit your current skills system, identify gaps, assess your AI maturity, and produce a deployment plan with feasibility scoring. It's the natural entry point before any investment decision.
